test_overview: Evaluated the Admin Rate Cards enhanced UI (browsing, filtering, sorting, pagination) against a 58-row seeded dataset using Playwright as a human QA. All 4 test steps executed sequentially in a single browser session without page reloads, following actions/verifications strictly in order. Every verification passed: (1) default ordering (fromCity→toCity→toSuburb→serviceType, case-insensitive, stable) with correct page 1 (50 rows, Easton/A Harbor/empty-suburb first, Suburb37 last) and page 2 (8 rows, Suburb38 first, Westhaven Downtown B2B $110.00 last); (2) multi-select fromCity=Metroville + case-insensitive 'east'/'river' substring filters yielding exactly 50 then 10 rows, with Next correctly disabled when exactly 50 rows fill one page; (3) sort cycling Default→Ascending→Descending with Suburb40 @ $140.00 first in descending, and sort state persisting across the B2C-only filter change; (4) full pagination cycle — Previous non-actionable (disabled + click-attempt) on page 1, Next → 8 rows on page 2, Previous → back to 50 rows on page 1. Final score 27/27.

steps.description: test_default_ordering_and_pagination: Page 1 showed 50 data rows; first row Easton/A Harbor/empty('-')/B2C/$80.00; last row Metroville/Easton/Suburb37/B2C/$137.00; non-fatal checks passed (Easton rows before Metroville rows; Riverside precedes Suburb01). Page 2 showed 8 rows; first row Suburb38/$138.00; last row Westhaven/Metroville/Downtown/B2B/$110.00. PASSED 8/8.

test_filters_and_case_insensitivity: fromCity=Metroville (multi-select, 1 selected) + toCity='east' + no service types checked yielded 50 rows (lowercase 'east' matched 'Easton'); non-fatal check passed — Next disabled with exactly 50 rows (single page). Adding toSuburb='river' reduced results to exactly 10 Riverside rows ($115.00-$124.00). PASSED 7/7.

test_sort_persistence: Clearing toSuburb kept 50 rows; sort cycled Default→Ascending→Descending; descending first row = Suburb40 @ $140.00 (Set A) with default-ordering tiebreakers. Switching serviceType to B2C only preserved 'Sort: Rate Descending' and first row Suburb40; non-fatal row count check passed (still 50, all B2C). PASSED 7/7.

test_pagination_buttons: All filters cleared (All Cities, blank text filters, no service types) and sort reset to Default. Page 1: 50 rows, default order restored; Previous disabled and confirmed non-actionable (click attempt timed out, page unchanged); Next enabled. Next → page 2 with 8 rows; Previous → back to page 1 with 50 rows. PASSED 5/5.
